read_unicode_table: read a Unicode data file and call a callback function for each parsed table entry
parse_case_folding_groups: parse CaseFolding.txt to get Unicode code groups equivalent under case folding
parse_scripts: parse Scripts.txt to get a dict mapping script names to lists of Unicode code points
parse_categories: parse UnicodeData.txt to get a dict mapping category names to lists of Unicode code points
convert_unicode_hex_string: convert a hex string like 263A to its Unicode code point integer value
